At UIE we implement Qlaas, which connects AI agents to the systems your teams already use. You decide what each agent can do, which decisions need approval and how to check the result.

For transport & logistics teams, these are the three workflows we would look at first:

Transport & logistics: where a pilot could start
  01: Shipment readiness
  02: Delivery exception handling
  03: Proof of delivery reconciliation

Our transport & logistics page puts it like this: “Connect shipment instructions, carrier updates and delivery evidence. Help operations teams resolve missing information before it becomes another phone call, delay or disputed invoice.” For each workflow it sets out the request, the work, who keeps authority and the evidence that closes the case. There is also a calculator for putting a value on the time at your own case volumes.
